newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE NAME 21-MAN SQUAD FOR IRELAND MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRANCE NAME 21-MAN SQUAD FOR IRELAND MATCH.

text.p: France on Wednesday named a 21-man squad to prepare for their opening Five Nations rugby union championship match against Ireland in Dublin on January 18.
Scrum-half Guy Accoceberry is a surprise omission, with Fabien Galthie of Colomiers being preferred.
Long-term injury victim Philippe Saint-Andre is still unavailable and back row forward Abdelatif Benazzi retains the captaincy he held for the two-test series against South Africa last year.
The team will be announced next Wednesday.

Forwards - Christian Califano, Franck Tournaire, Jean-Louis Jordana, Marc Dal Maso, Marc de Rougemont, Olivier Merle, Fabien Pelous, Hugues Miorin, Abdelatif Benazzi (captain), Philippe Benetton, Richard Castel.
Backs - Fabien Galthie, Philippe Carbonneau, Alain Penaud, Christophe Lamaison, Thomas Castaignede, Stephane Glas, Richard Dourthe, Emile Ntamack, David Venditti, Jean-Luc Sadourny.
